title: New pull request alert
description: The alert for one newly opened pull request: who sent it, what it is about, what it touches and what to watch. A PR alerted before (an update) is an empty alerts array.

checked_at.description: when the trigger fired, from the message's last line

alerts.description: the one PR the payload hands over; empty for an update

author_kind.description: member: OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR; regular: CONTRIBUTOR, or earlier PRs here; first_time: FIRST_TIME_CONTRIBUTOR, FIRST_TIMER, or no earlier PR here

author_history.description: GitHub's author_association, then the search's total_count as it answered: "<ASSOCIATION>; <total_count> PRs here incl. this one", or "<ASSOCIATION>; history not read"

summary.description: what the PR says it does, from its title and body, in one or two sentences

touches.description: files and areas changed, CI, auth, dependencies and release paths named first

watch.description: what a maintainer should look at before anything else; empty when nothing stands out

not_read.description: what could not be read and why (a 403 or 429 is GitHub's anonymous limit)

asked.description: the shortest quote that shows what it asked
